prompt:
Subject: bistro, target meaning "小さな居酒屋".

Composition: Show a cozy little bistro facade with two tiny round outdoor tables, checked tablecloths and a pot of red flowers by the entrance.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Use only attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Thick rounded dark chocolate outlines, simple rounded 2D shapes, clean smooth solid color fills, few restrained flat shadow shapes. All silhouettes clean smooth closed outlined shapes including water or grass. Avoid light beams, wind swirls and glows unless essential to word meaning.
en: A small bistro has outdoor tables beneath a striped awning.
ja: 縞模様の日よけの下にテーブルを置いた、小さなビストロの店先。
